defect: The rewritten wait loop is entered when progress is null (via the !progress branch) and then dereferences progress->cancelled, and it also dereferences the bool pointer progress->cancelled without checking it, although RequestProgress defaults cancelled to nullptr, so ReadAllWithProgress segfaults.
reason: The old loop only ran when the cancelled pointer was non-null; the new condition and the if inside it are lines this change wrote, and the fix adds exactly the missing null checks.

defect: Thread selection now takes the head of threadReadyQueue, but the queue bookkeeping is wrong: __KernelReSchedule marks the running thread READY (and queues it) even on the early-return interrupt/callback paths, and __KernelSwitchContext's inverted updates leave the switched-to thread in the queue with status READY instead of RUNNING.
reason: Before this change the ready queue was not used for scheduling, so this change both added the misplaced ReSchedule lines the fix moves and made the inverted switch-context bookkeeping (outside the diff hunks) take effect.

defect: The Savestate Slot submenu accelerator label was changed from F3 to F2, so the menu shows the quick-save key for next slot while the same commit's key map binds next slot to F3.
reason: The wrong label is in the one line this change edited, it duplicates the F2 shown for quick save two lines below, and the fix restores F3.

defect: The new StringFromFormat for GE_PROJMAP_NORMALIZED_NORMAL has two %s conversions but only one argument, so the second %s reads a missing vararg (undefined behaviour, garbage or crash in the generated shader).
reason: The format string was written by this change and the fix removes the first %s so the conversions match the single argument.

defect: The added SeekFile in npdrmLseek moves the underlying handle to data_offset+newPos, which is not block aligned (and is passed with the caller's relative whence), while npdrmRead decrypts whole blocks read from the handle's current position, so reads after a seek (even a tell-style or same-block seek that used to work) decrypt misaligned data.
reason: The fix replaces exactly this added line with a block-aligned seek and additionally seeks to the block start in npdrmRead; part of the seek handling was already incomplete before, but the misaligned seek is new in this change.

defect: The fix widens detection of GPU_SUPPORTS_INSTANCE_RENDERING to GLES3 and desktop GL 3.1, where gl_InstanceID is core, instead of only EXT_gpu_shader4.
reason: The narrower check only leaves hardware tessellation disabled on those drivers (the flag merely gates the feature), so the fix extends a capability rather than repairing wrong behaviour.

defect: SampleNearest passes texbufwidth*8 as row_pitch_bits, but texbufwidth counts texels, so the row pitch is wrong for every non-8-bit format (16-bit, 32-bit and CLUT4 textures sample the wrong rows, also in the swizzled path).
reason: The old code used texel-sized rows (width*texel_size_bits) and this change introduced the byte-assumed pitch, which the fix corrects by multiplying by texel_size_bits/8; knowing that bufw is in texels needs the texture cache or GE docs.

defect: The mouse deltas were moved from zero-initialized statics to uninitialized locals mouseDeltaX and mouseDeltaY, which the per-frame mouse-control block reads and scales before any SDL_MOUSEMOTION event sets them (undefined behaviour, spurious axis input).
reason: The uninitialized declarations are lines this change added and the fix initializes them to 0.

defect: The new integer-scale code always rounds the output width to multiples of 480, but in rotated (portrait) mode the displayed width is 272 pixels, so portrait output is not an integer scale.
reason: The rounding block was added by this change, the rotated flag is computed in the same function, and the fix picks 272 when rotated.

defect: The rewrite tests writability of the exe directory instead of memstickpath, so a custom installed.txt path is replaced by Documents whenever the exe directory is read-only and the test file left in the exe directory is never deleted, and it builds the paths from File::GetExeDirectory, which returns an ANSI rather than UTF-8 path.
reason: The fix changes exactly these new lines, testing memstickpath and converting a wide exe directory to UTF-8; the test-path mismatch is visible in the diff, the encoding part needs FileUtil.cpp.
